item.title: Microsoft adds local file access to Copilot via Hybrid Intelligence
item.description:
Microsoft adds local file access to Copilot via Hybrid Intelligence

At the Windows and Surface event, Microsoft unveiled an upgrade to its Copilot AI system that lets the assistant read local files on a PC and act across the operating system.

🔍 Overview

Microsoft calls the new approach Hybrid Intelligence – a mix of local and cloud AI models that lets apps and tools complete tasks efficiently.

🧩 How it works

  • Hybrid Intelligence gives Copilot permission to scan folders on the Windows PC, locate files, rename them, zip them, and draft emails.
  • During the demo, Jacob Andreou, Microsoft’s EVP of Copilot, asked the Autopilot agent to help file taxes. The agent used Hybrid Intelligence to find the accountant’s needed documents, package them, and prepare a message with the zip file attached.
  • The same technology powers a refreshed Windows search experience that lets users perform quick actions directly from the search bar.

⚙️ Key features

  • Local file access – Copilot can browse the user’s folders and use the contents to carry out tasks.
  • Cross‑OS actions – The assistant can rename files, create zip archives, and send emails without leaving the AI chat.
  • Quick‑action search – The new Windows search bar includes in‑line controls such as a dark‑mode toggle, a microphone‑volume slider, and a one‑click option to send a text.

🚀 Availability

  • Features powered by Hybrid Intelligence will roll out over the “next couple months,” according to Jacob Andreou.
  • The new Windows search experience ships this fall on Windows 11 PCs, announced by Windows and Surface boss Pavan Davuluri.

#Microsoft #Copilot #HybridIntelligence #Windows11

Source: Microsoft is giving Copilot more control over Windows and your files

item.title: Microsoft unveils Surface Laptop Ultra with Nvidia RTX Spark and Hybrid Intelligence
item.description:
Microsoft unveils Surface Laptop Ultra with Nvidia RTX Spark and Hybrid Intelligence

Microsoft just wrapped up a big Windows and Surface‑focused keynote in San Francisco. The headline announcement was the Surface Laptop Ultra, a new laptop powered by Nvidia’s RTX Spark Arm‑based chip.

🔍 Overview

  • Surface Laptop Ultra runs on Nvidia’s RTX Spark, an Arm‑based processor that can support up to 128 GB of unified memory.
  • It ships with a 15‑inch HDR touchscreen that can reach up to 2,000 nits of peak brightness.
  • The device replaces the old proprietary Surface Connect port with a magnetic USB‑C charging connector that Microsoft calls Magnetic Connect.
  • Microsoft also announced the Surface RTX Spark Dev Box, a developer‑focused mini PC that runs the same RTX Spark platform.

🧩 How it works

  • RTX Spark chip – an Arm‑based processor designed for high‑performance creative software, gaming, and local AI tasks.
  • Hybrid Intelligence – a Windows update that lets Copilot access files stored on the PC and perform actions. In a live demo, Copilot searched folders, renamed files, zipped them, and drafted an email with the attachment.
  • Dev Box – equipped with 128 GB of unified memory, a 100‑watt thermal envelope and Nvidia Tensor cores, enabling local AI models exceeding 120 B parameters and a strong gaming capability.

⚙️ Key specifications

  • Display: 15‑inch HDR touchscreen, up to 2,000 nits peak brightness
  • Memory (base config): 24 GB RAM
  • Storage (base config): 512 GB SSD
  • Charging: Magnetic USB‑C (Magnetic Connect)
  • Trackpad: Larger surface with haptic feedback
  • Processor: Nvidia RTX Spark Arm‑based chip (up to 128 GB unified memory)
Product RAM Storage Price Release date
Surface Laptop Ultra 24 GB 512 GB $2,599 October 16
Surface RTX Spark Dev Box 128 GB unified – $5,999 (pre‑order) November (shipping)

🚀 Availability

  • Surface Laptop Ultra starts at $2,599 for the base configuration and will be available on October 16.
  • Surface RTX Spark Dev Box is available for preorder at $5,999 and is slated to ship in November.

💡 Why it matters

  • Both devices target the premium end of the laptop and PC market, offering hardware capable of running demanding creative apps, games, and on‑device AI workloads.
  • The Hybrid Intelligence integration gives Copilot the ability to act on local files, expanding the usefulness of AI within Windows.
  • The Dev Box’s developer‑optimized Windows 11 Pro setup and preinstalled tools (VS Code, Git, GitHub Copilot, WSL, Python, Node) make it a ready‑to‑use platform for AI model testing, prototyping agents, and on‑device coding assistance.

#Surface #Nvidia #AI #HybridIntelligence #Windows

Source: Everything announced at Microsoft’s Surface Laptop Ultra event Source: Surface RTX Spark Dev Box is available for preorder for $5,999

item.title: Nouveau/NVK Driver Runs on NVIDIA Spark Box After Extensive Patching
item.description:
Nouveau/NVK Driver Runs on NVIDIA Spark Box After Extensive Patching

After much back and forth and hoops jumping, I can finally reveal nouveau/nvk running on a NVIDIA Spark box.

🔍 Overview

  • The open‑source nouveau/nvk driver has been demonstrated on a NVIDIA Spark platform.
  • The effort involved a large patch series and new firmware.

🛠️ What was required

  • 100 patches were prepared for the driver.
  • A new firmware was required for the hardware.
  • The author notes it “might mean it’s a wait for nova type situation” when considering upstream integration.

🚀 Availability

  • Upstreaming is still uncertain; the author is “not sure how best to upstream it all.”
  • No official release or integration status is provided beyond the demonstration.

📺 Watching the demo

  • To view the live stream of the demonstration, go to the YouTube schedule overview and hover over the paperclip to see the ‘Live Stream’ link.
  • Live streams are only available for A/V assisted tracks.
  • For a two‑way conversation during the stream, you need a Matrix account, join the Linux Plumbers Space, and find the room corresponding to the track you’re watching.

⚠️ ACPI Operation Region Conflicts (Related Kernel Insight)

  • Many people mistakenly think warnings like ACPI Warning: SystemIO range … conflicts with OpRegion … indicate a firmware bug; this is generally untrue.
  • The Advanced Configuration and Power Interface (ACPI) specification abstracts hardware details.
  • ACPI provides information as code via the ACPI Source Language (ASL), which is compiled into bytecode interpreted by the OS at runtime.
  • ASL can define Operation Regions that map to hardware registers.
  • Example: an operation region OPR1 at I/O port 0x400, 2 bytes long, with 8‑bit fields INDX and DATA.
  • ACPI methods lock access to these registers; however, a Linux driver that accesses the hardware directly has no knowledge of ACPI and can race with ACPI methods.
  • The kernel detects such conflicts and emits warnings such as: ACPI Warning: SystemIO range 0x0000000000000400-0x000000000000401 conflicts with OpRegion 0x0000000000000400-0x0000000000000401 (OPR1).
  • This warning indicates a driver is attempting to allocate I/O ports that an ACPI operation region already claims.

All statements are drawn directly from the provided evidence.

#Nouveau #NVK #NVIDIA #Linux #ACPI

Source: Kernel Planet

item.title: Open‑Source RemoveMacAI Tool Deletes Apple Intelligence Models, Frees Up Storage
item.description:
Open‑Source RemoveMacAI Tool Deletes Apple Intelligence Models, Frees Up Storage

A new open‑source command‑line utility called RemoveMacAI lets macOS users delete Apple Intelligence models and disable its bundled AI features in a single step, reclaiming roughly a dozen gigabytes of disk space.

🔧 What RemoveMacAI Does

  • ‘RemoveMacAI’ switches off Apple’s AI features, deletes its AI models, and blocks them from being downloaded again.
  • It removes the on‑disk foundation models, which the developer says take up about 12 GB of space (some users report even more).
  • The changes persist across macOS updates.
  • Dictation continues to work after removal.
  • The tool provides a removemacai revert command to re‑enable all features and allow the models to download again.
  • A removemacai status command shows the size of each individual AI model on the Mac.

“I wrote RemoveMacAI to do all of it in one go.”

📦 Storage Impact

  • Apple Intelligence models remain on disk by default, occupying about 12 GB according to the developer.
  • A user measured 35.05 GB of space labeled “Apple Intelligence” on a MacBook Air.
  • Running RemoveMacAI deletes these models, freeing the corresponding storage.

⚙️ How It Works

  1. The tool toggles off the following AI‑related features:
    • Siri
    • Writing Tools
    • Genmoji
    • Image Playground
    • The ChatGPT extension
    • All summary functions
  2. It then deletes the stored foundation models from the file system.
  3. Finally, it prevents macOS from re‑downloading the models unless the user runs removemacai revert.

📋 Feature List

Feature Action performed by RemoveMacAI
Siri Turned off
Writing Tools Turned off
Genmoji Turned off
Image Playground Turned off
ChatGPT extension Turned off
Summaries Turned off

📆 Availability

  • The utility is open‑source and was announced by its developer on Reddit.
  • It replaces the single Settings toggle that existed for disabling Apple Intelligence before it was removed in macOS 27, where the models stayed on disk and settings were split across multiple panes (including several under Screen Time).

💡 Why It Matters

  • Users who prefer not to run Apple’s on‑device AI can now remove the models entirely, reclaiming storage without losing core functionality like Dictation.
  • The tool simplifies what previously required navigating about a dozen settings across various preference panes.
  • By blocking future downloads, it ensures the storage savings remain until the user decides to restore the features.

#AppleIntelligence #macOS #OpenSource #CLI

Source: An open-source tool lets you delete 12GB of Apple Intelligence data on macOS

item.title: Apple to Tighten Mac Full Disk Access Controls Amid AI Agent Risks
item.description:
Apple to Tighten Mac Full Disk Access Controls Amid AI Agent Risks

Apple has announced plans to tighten the way apps are granted Full Disk Access on macOS, citing growing risks as AI agents become more capable and autonomous. The company warned that this broad permission can expose highly sensitive data and bypasses the privacy controls normally used to protect user data.

🔍 Overview

Full Disk Access is one of the broadest permissions available in macOS. While it is intended for software like backup tools, it allows apps to reach data that is otherwise protected behind separate privacy controls. Apple reports that some developers are currently using this permission in ways that could put users at risk by exposing several types of data:

  • Personal files
  • Email messages
  • Messages
  • Browsing history
  • Sensitive data across large parts of a system

⚙️ Key Details

Apple directly linked the upcoming changes to the rise of agentic AI software. Unlike traditional apps that might need access for a single function, AI agents can carry out tasks across multiple apps, files, and services.

Feature Description
Permission Level One of the broadest in macOS; bypasses standard privacy controls.
Original Intent Designed for utilities such as backup software.
Current Concern AI agents may expose significantly more personal info than traditional apps.
Privacy Stance Positioned as a central part of Apple’s on-device and cloud-based AI processing.

🧩 How it Works

The company intends to introduce additional controls that require more explicit user action before an app can receive Full Disk Access. The goal of these protections is to ensure users clearly understand the risks involved and make a deliberate, informed decision before granting such broad access to their data.

🚀 Availability

Apple has not announced exactly what the new Full Disk Access controls will look like or when they will arrive. The company stated only that the additional protections will be introduced going forward as it continues to expand artificial intelligence across the Mac through Apple Intelligence and Siri AI.

#Apple #macOS #AIAgents #Privacy #Cybersecurity

Source: Apple plans tougher Mac Full Disk Access controls as AI agents expand

item.title: Rabbit Launches Standalone OS3 Agentic Operating System
item.description:
Rabbit Launches Standalone OS3 Agentic Operating System

Rabbit is releasing a standalone AI agent called OS3, an “agentic operating system” that can be used without the company’s R1 hardware.

🧩 How it works

OS3 runs in the cloud but operates locally across Windows, Mac, and Linux devices. The system is designed to automatically determine the following components required to complete a task:

  • Devices
  • Files
  • Apps
  • AI models

⚙️ Key details

  • Account Capacity: Users can add up to five devices and their preferred AI models to one account.
  • Privacy: Rabbit claims OS3 will not store, copy, use, or sell user data, though it will keep chats and associated memories on its servers. Data handled by other linked AI providers is subject to those providers’ own privacy rules.

🚀 Availability

OS3 can be accessed through several methods:

  • A dedicated desktop site
  • Paired messaging apps such as iMessage or Telegram
  • The Rabbit R1 device

💡 Why it matters

Founder Jesse Lyu has informed Wired that Rabbit has stopped manufacturing R1 devices. However, the company is focusing on a new vibe-coding “cyberdeck” designed to run OS3, which is expected to launch within “months.”

#Rabbit #OS3 #AIagents #AIhardware

Source: Rabbit’s new AI agent doesn’t need an R1 to run

item.title: Apple Rolls Out Siri AI and New Software Updates Across Platforms
item.description:
Apple Rolls Out Siri AI and New Software Updates Across Platforms

Apple has begun rolling out Siri AI, the next generation of Apple Intelligence, alongside powerful parental controls and software improvements across iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS 27, and other Apple platforms.

🔍 Overview

Siri AI is an entirely new version of Siri powered by the next generation of Apple Intelligence. It is deeply integrated into iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro, offering a more conversational assistant with broad world knowledge and personal context understanding.

⚙️ Key Details

Feature Capability
Siri AI Understands personal context across emails, messages, and photos; utilizes onscreen awareness and web access for up-to-date information.
Siri Mode Integrated into the iPhone Camera app to take action on things in front of the user, such as splitting bills via Apple Cash or adding Wallet passes.
Visual Intelligence Allows users on iPhone, iPad, and Mac to ask about screen content; Vision Pro users can ask about their surroundings.
Write with Siri Generates drafts or refines existing text based on user descriptions.
Siri App Uses iCloud to privately sync conversational history across all user products.
Image Playground Creates high-quality images in various styles, including photorealistic, with metadata and upcoming SynthID support.
Safari Tools Automatically organizes tabs into topics, notifies users of price drops or restocks, and enables custom extensions.
Call Context Surfaces reservation numbers or confirmation codes when calling a business.
Photos Tools Includes Spatial Reframing, Extend, and an upgraded Clean Up tool.

🛡️ Parental Controls

New intuitive features allow parents to manage digital experiences for children:

  • App Management: Parents can choose specific apps children access and add more over time.
  • Ask to Browse: Requires parental approval before children access new websites in Safari.
  • Communication Safety: Detects and blocks violent content or gore in shared images and videos; allows parents to approve new contacts.
  • Screen Time: Offers an at-a-glance view of average usage and top apps, with the ability to set daily time allowances for Social Media, Games, and Entertainment apps.
  • Schedules: Manages app access at different points of the day.
  • Setup Flow: A new process for child accounts to enable age-based safeguards across the system.

🚀 Availability

Siri AI is currently rolling out as a beta in English. Support for Spanish, Portuguese, Korean, Japanese, and French is scheduled for October.

💡 Why it matters

The 2027 software releases introduce platform improvements in connectivity, search, and performance. Specific performance gains include:

  • Apps launch up to 30 percent faster on iPhone and iPad.
  • Photos load up to 70 percent faster after being taken on iPhone and iPad.
  • AirDrop transfers are up to 80 percent faster on iPhone and iPad.

#Apple #SiriAI #AppleIntelligence #iOS27 #ParentalControls

Source: Major updates for Apple’s software platforms are now available

item.title: Proton-Autogen launches Windows executables on Linux without manual configuration
item.description:
Proton-Autogen launches Windows executables on Linux without manual configuration

Proton-Autogen is a new, lightweight Linux utility designed to streamline the execution of Windows applications by automatically managing Proton and Wine environments. It eliminates the need for manual Steam shortcut creation or complex prefix configuration, allowing users to run executables directly through their file manager.

🧩 How it works

Proton-Autogen functions as an orchestration layer that automates the setup of runtime environments. When a user selects a Windows .exe file, the tool detects available Proton installations and configures the environment to optimize compatibility. In cases where Proton cannot be used, the utility provides automatic Wine fallback support.

⚙️ Key details

  • Integration: Features native support for Nautilus (GNOME), Nemo (Cinnamon), and Dolphin (KDE Plasma) file managers.
  • Compatibility: Supports Proton-CachyOS, GE-Proton, and custom Proton builds.
  • Interface: Built with a GTK4 graphical interface, including advanced options and a CLI.
  • Diagnostics: Includes integrated tools to generate reports for troubleshooting via the proton-autogen --diag command.
  • Maintenance: Automatically handles prefix management and runtime detection.

🚀 Availability

The recommended installation method for Ubuntu-based systems is via the official PPA:

sudo add-apt-repository ppa:n3oray/proton-autogen sudo apt update sudo apt install proton-autogen

#Linux #Proton #Wine #Gaming #OpenSource

Source: N3oRay/proton-autogen

item.title: Apple Announces September 14 Release Date for iOS 27 and Other Updates
item.description:
Apple Announces September 14 Release Date for iOS 27 and Other Updates

Apple has announced that its next generation of software updates, first unveiled at WWDC26, will be released on Monday, September 14. These updates will be available as free downloads for compatible devices across the Apple ecosystem.

⚙️ Key details

The updates introduce major upgrades including design refinements, performance improvements, and updates to various apps. A primary focus of the release is the introduction of new Apple Intelligence and Siri AI features.

Operating System Key Features and Improvements
iOS 27 Siri AI, Apple Intelligence, Visual Intelligence, expanded customization, and upgrades to Photos, Safari, Messages, Mail, Passwords, Shortcuts, and Home
iPadOS 27 Apple Intelligence features and iPad-specific productivity improvements
macOS 27 Golden Gate Siri AI, Visual Intelligence, Apple Intelligence features, and performance improvements
watchOS 27 New Siri, fitness, health, and Smart Stack capabilities

🚀 Availability

In addition to the major operating systems, Apple is releasing tvOS 27, visionOS 27, HomePod software 27, and new AirPods firmware on September 14. Following developer betas in June and public betas in July, users can install the updates via the following methods:

  • iPhone and iPad: Settings > General > Software Update
  • Mac: System Settings > General > Software Update
  • Apple Watch: Through the Watch app on a paired iPhone
  • Apple TV and Apple Vision Pro: Through Settings

#Apple #iOS27 #AppleIntelligence #SiriAI #SoftwareUpdate

Source: Apple confirms release dates for iOS 27, macOS 27, watchOS 27 and more
